# Proposed architecture decision

**Status: Proposed — project acceptance required.**

Engine 0.8.0; catalog 0.4.0; services 0.8.0; analysis 0.2.0.
Input SHA-256: 2410b17ffe7b48b1a53e3383a668a754f31eef28e8d327a3eef71a5d327d284a.

## Original result

PROVISIONAL STACK — unresolved critical constraints require review before production\. modular\_monolith recommendation selected from 49 complete compatible plans; month\-12 infrastructure planning band USD 686\.87–858\.06/month\.
Result: ok_with_warnings.

- frontend: React / Vite — Covers requested targets web with spa rendering\. Team languages: csharp, javascript, sql\. Selected after supporting\-service compatibility and whole\-plan infrastructure cost scoring\. Explicit critical warnings identify provisional data\-flow/control exceptions\.
- backend: ASP\.NET Core — Provides a dotnet application runtime for the internal\_tool profile\. Language familiarity and delivery complexity were compared across compatible whole plans\. Selected after supporting\-service compatibility and whole\-plan infrastructure cost scoring\. Explicit critical warnings identify provisional data\-flow/control exceptions\.
- database: PostgreSQL — relational persistence via Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server \(Central India, local/zone backups\)\.  Database drivers and host deployment were checked as a combination\. Selected after supporting\-service compatibility and whole\-plan infrastructure cost scoring\. Explicit critical warnings identify provisional data\-flow/control exceptions\.
- hosting: Azure App Service Environment v3 \(Central India, Linux Iv2\) — Matches managed\_cloud with provider azure; reviewed primary compute region centralindia\. Required runtimes and separate database deployment were checked\. Selected after supporting\-service compatibility and whole\-plan infrastructure cost scoring\. Explicit critical warnings identify provisional data\-flow/control exceptions\.

Monthly infrastructure/operations band (activity fees additional): USD 686.87–858.06.

## Complete alternatives

- modular\_monolith\|react\|aspnet\|pg\|ase\-india\|centralindia; score 61; USD 686.87–858.06; selected.
- modular\_monolith\|react\|fastify\|pg\|ase\-india\|centralindia; score 61; USD 686.87–858.06; alternative.
- modular\_monolith\|vue\|aspnet\|pg\|ase\-india\|centralindia; score 61; USD 686.87–858.06; alternative.

## Preference stability

Original winner retained in 25/25 tested settings; 1 observed winners. Counts are not confidence probabilities.

## Cost assumptions

- Horizon: expected month\-12 footprint; 730 hours/month\. No tax, development/on\-call labor, domain registration or new on\-prem hardware procurement is included\.
- Peak concurrency supplied: 300; not equated directly with requests/second\.
- RPS absent: assumed 50 requests/user/day averaged across the day \(0\.868 RPS\); peak capacity still uses the concurrency hypothesis\.
- Data volume 20 GB supplied; egress 15 GB/month assumed at 0\.01 GB per year\-12 user, minimum 1 GB; backup retention 1 months assumed\.
- Compute provisioning hypothesis: 50 RPS or 1000 active users per reference allocation; WebSocket capacity is included in the peak\-concurrency replica floor, not charged again as per\-connection sidecars\. 2\.25 vCPU/2\-GiB\-equivalent units include frontend/backend, auth, workers, inference and telemetry once\. These are sizing assumptions requiring load tests, not capacity guarantees\.
- Billed duty 1–1; run polling workers with allocated CPU/minimum instances\. Higher availability adds at least two application allocations and in\-region database copies, but does not guarantee an SLA\. Rate bands include headroom; do not interpret reference regions/proxies as exact local provider quotes\.
- Azure ASE: 2 whole Linux I1 v2 instances \(2 vCPU each\), rounding the reference CPU footprint up and retaining the availability replica floor\. Published consumption meter is region/SKU\-specific; database/storage/network/operations lines remain planning proxies, not a calibrated Azure quote\. Configure in\-region PostgreSQL backups, Blob LRS, log retention and internal access; no dedicated physical hosts or cross\-region copies assumed\.
- Managed database: 1 vCPU/4 GiB reference primary and 1 failover copies in\-region; no SLA is guaranteed\. Auth/search/outbox share logical database capacity and are not billed as duplicate databases\.
- Headline estimate and budget fit cover infrastructure/operations only\. Payment and SMS activity fees are separately itemized scenarios and excluded from this total; missing volumes are assumptions, not measured expenditure\.
- Authored backup\-storage envelope with retained copy quantity; no cross\-region copy assumed\.
- Authored hosted build\-minute allowance, assuming included quota at the lower bound\. Paid runners/minutes/artifacts require a repository\-specific quote and spending cap\.
- Authored internet\-egress envelope; actual destination, free quota and routes vary\.
- Authored logs/metrics/request\-operations allowance; redact data and set regional retention/quotas\.
- Authored regional persistent\-storage envelope, including replica copies explicitly in quantity\.
- Authored standard\-storage envelope; requests/lifecycle operations have a separate allowance\.
- Central India primary Linux I1 v2 consumption meter at USD 0\.395/instance\-hour, reviewed 13 November 2026\. Whole 2\-vCPU instances, no discounts/tax/dedicated host; autoscaling and quota require review\.
- Cloud SQL memory reference; a declared proxy for other managed providers, not their quoted rate\.
- Cloud SQL reference CPU with up to 2x geography/SKU allowance; other providers use this declared proxy pending exact quotes\.

## Blockers, validation and owner actions

- critical: Microsoft Entra ID \(tenant OIDC/SAML integration\) is proposed provisionally: end\-to\-end india data residency is NOT established\. Verify tenant/merchant eligibility, processing, logs, backups, delivery partners and contracts before production\. This warning is an explicit exception to verified residency, not approval\.
- warning: 99\.9% is a target, not a product guarantee\. The cost model provisions redundancy assumptions; service terms, failover and workload behavior still require verification\.
- warning: Infrastructure estimate USD 686\.87–858\.06/month exceeds the USD 300 budget at the lower bound; this is an explicitly over\-budget plan, with no requirement silently relaxed\.
- warning: The output proposes technical control designs only\. It does not certify compliance, establish legal applicability, execute contracts, or replace an audit\. Implement controls and obtain scope\-specific review\.
- warning: Legacy reuse requires version/EOL, license, network, schema and identity integration checks; no migration or connectivity is assumed verified\.
- warning: No measured evidence establishes the 800 ms p95 target; load\-test the complete client/network/data path\.
- warning: Planning bands combine published reference rates and explicitly authored allowances; they are not regional provider quotes or measured workload capacity\. Validate sizing, merchant/SMS eligibility, storage, requests and current tariffs before purchase\.
- infrastructure\.data\_residency, requirements\.auth: Ask the tenant owner for the identity boundary and connectivity details\. Microsoft 365 content geography does not establish Entra identity residency\.

Separate services/identity not covered\.
- core:azure\-pg\-backup: [Azure PostgreSQL backup and restore](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/postgresql/backup-restore/concepts-backup-restore); checked 2026\-11\-13; Use in\-region local/zone backup storage; disable geo\-redundancy and cross\-region read replicas for this profile\.
- core:azure\-pg\-regions: [Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/postgresql/overview); checked 2026\-11\-13; Central India Intel compute and in\-region HA support\. Exact SKU availability/quota and deployment configuration still need review\.
- core:pg: [PostgreSQL introduction](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/intro-whatis.html); checked 2026\-11\-13; Relational engine, transactional integrity
- core:react: [React from scratch](https://react.dev/learn/build-a-react-app-from-scratch); checked 2026\-11\-13; Client web apps; SSR requires additional framework work
- services:aws\-logs: [CloudWatch Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/WhatIsCloudWatchLogs.html); checked 2026\-11\-13; Regional logging configuration required\.
- services:azure\-ase\-retail: [Azure App Service Central India retail pricing API](https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices); checked 2026\-11\-13; Checked exact primary Linux I1 v2 consumption meter in centralindia: USD 0\.395/instance\-hour\. Snapshot in docs/research/azure\-ase\-price\.json; no customer discount/tax or capacity guarantee\.
- services:azure\-storage\-boundary: [Azure Storage redundancy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-redundancy); checked 2026\-11\-13; LRS retains replicas within primary region; do not enable geo\-redundancy or cross\-region copies for this scoped profile\.
- services:azure\-storage\-region: [Azure Storage regional routing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/network-routing-preference); checked 2026\-11\-13; Central India Storage regional endpoint support; account SKU/network configuration and quota must be verified before provisioning\.
- services:ci: [GitHub Actions](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/about-github-actions/understanding-github-actions); checked 2026\-11\-13; Build only source/synthetic tests; no production data exports\.
- services:entra\-oidc: [Microsoft identity platform OIDC](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols-oidc); checked 2026\-11\-13; Tenant\-scoped OIDC discovery and token protocols; configure issuer/audience, keys, claims and consent; no residency/contract assurance\.
- services:entra\-residency: [Microsoft Entra data residency](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/fundamentals/data-residency); checked 2026\-11\-13; Tenant geography and identity storage are distinct from application regions and Microsoft 365 content residency\. No India\-only tenant assurance inferred\.
- services:gcp\-logs: [Regional Cloud Logging](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/regionalized-logs); checked 2026\-11\-13; Regional log buckets and routing configuration\.
- services:s3\-price: [S3 pricing](https://aws.amazon.com/s3/pricing/); checked 2026\-11\-13; Storage, requests and egress vary; cross\-provider estimate below is a planning envelope\.
- services:sql\-price: [Cloud SQL pricing](https://cloud.google.com/sql/pricing); checked 2026\-11\-13; Reference CPU $0\.0413/vCPU\-hour and memory $0\.007/GiB\-hour; HA replicas billed; not an India\-specific quote\.
- services:storage\-price: [Cloud Storage pricing](https://cloud.google.com/storage/pricing); checked 2026\-11\-13; Storage, operations and network are distinct charges\.
- services:telemetry: [OpenTelemetry Collector](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/collector/); checked 2026\-11\-13; Collection/redaction/export; backend retention must be configured\.

## Limits and acceptance

- Exploratory analysis only. The original recommendation and original requirements are unchanged.
- Priority stability counts a finite one-at-a-time sweep; it is not a probability, confidence score or exhaustive sensitivity analysis.
- The tradeoff front covers all complete candidates in this finite reviewed catalog, minimizing cost upper bound and operated components while maximizing the ORIGINAL-priority heuristic score. It does not establish real-world optimality or measured architecture quality.
- Functional experiments try eligible single/pair edits only: phone login to email/password, payments off, offline support off, full-text search off, or unsupported ML off. They are changed projects, never solutions satisfying the original brief.
- Compliance, infrastructure/residency/provider, tenant isolation, availability, budget, team and timeline are never relaxed. A usable hypothetical result is not legal, security or production approval.
- No user assertion authenticates vendor/tenant evidence. Missing contracts, capacity calibration and independent review remain unresolved.
- The generated ADR is Proposed; no stakeholder acceptance, implementation or deployment is inferred.

Acceptance, independent review, vendor eligibility, implementation and deployment remain owner tasks. No acceptance is recorded.

score_breakdown.reason: USD 686.87–858.06/month versus budget 300: fit 5 when upper bound fits, 3 when only lower fits, 1 within twice budget, otherwise 0. All selected services are included under disclosed assumptions.
Language familiarity 5.00/5 and implementation-complexity rubric 2.75/5; short delivery/beginner-complexity and manual Markdown-conversion penalties are explicit heuristics.
